answer: The relic index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes a hostile operator to the back of the sable queue while honest participants promoted earlier continues earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 296 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the river. That is 34 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
